findings.issue: Nine quick-filter/selection spans and three sortable table headers are pointer-only.
findings.evidence: All 12 have tabIndex -1 and no keyboard role/handler; Enter on 403 chip leaves it inactive.
findings.recommendation: Use buttons for chips/header sorting, expose pressed/sort state.

findings.issue: Modals have no dialog semantics or keyboard/focus lifecycle.
findings.evidence: All three lack role=dialog, aria-modal and labelledby. Opening ingest leaves focus on trigger; Tab moves to background search; Escape does not close; two Tabs after final modal button reach background Refresh; closing does not restore trigger focus. Background remains non-inert and body overflow visible.
findings.recommendation: Native dialog or labelled accessible dialog with initial focus, trapping, Escape, restore focus, background inert and scroll containment.

findings.issue: Form controls lack programmatic label associations.
findings.evidence: All 14 static input/select/textarea elements have labels.length=0 and no aria-label. AX names are empty for visible three selects and master checkbox; search receives only placeholder fallback name. Modal label elements have no for attributes.
findings.recommendation: Associate persistent labels using for/id, give select-all and per-row checkboxes action-specific names.

findings.issue: Small white primary and success button text fails AA contrast.
findings.evidence: Measured CSS backgrounds #0284c7 and #059669; independent WCAG math gives 4.0953:1 and 3.7682:1 against white. Detector reports 8 blue and 4 green occurrences.
findings.recommendation: Darken fills or choose text/fill pairs at least 4.5:1.

findings.issue: Page-level overflow and compressed mobile header/workflow; card grid also exceeds narrow content width.
findings.evidence: True mobile emulation: document client/scroll width 390/443 and 320/443. Header scrollWidth 427. Workflow scrollWidth 418 in 340/270px client area. At 320 search remains 280px; cards empty child is 340px in 272px grid. No CSS media rules.
findings.recommendation: Wrap/collapse status header and workflow, fluid search width/min-width:0, card minmax(min(100%,340px),1fr), keep table overflow local.

findings.issue: Dense stacked tools displace results and mix filter, selection and export actions.
findings.evidence: Desktop 1440x900 has 30 visible clickable controls and table-card y395; mobile 390x844 table-card y921.5 (Chrome shrinks page to 443 CSS-pixel visual width); 320x740 y1047. Fixture notice contributes 31/46/61px respectively.
findings.recommendation: Prioritize ingest/search/triage, separate selection actions, group exports, progressively disclose secondary tools.

findings.issue: Compact controls and undersized functional copy.
findings.evidence: Desktop all 18 visible native controls and 27/30 click targets have one dimension below 44px. True 390px mobile: 17/18 native and 26/30 click targets below44. View buttons 22px high, quick chips26.5px, checkbox13x13px. Inspector copy text10.5px; row review buttons10px. 44px is design target, not automatic WCAG2.2 AA failure.
findings.recommendation: Increase coarse-pointer hit areas, readable labels and row controls while preserving desktop density.

findings.issue: Async feedback and toggle selection state are not conveyed accessibly.
findings.evidence: No aria-live/status/alert regions, no pressed/selected state on chips/view controls, no aria-sort on header sort controls.
findings.recommendation: Polite status/toast announcements, proper button states and aria-sort; meaningful close labels.

findings.issue: Filter/view state is not shareable and exports have inconsistent scoping.
findings.evidence: Activating403+cards leaves URL unchanged; reload resets both. Changing403+unreviewed leaves DOCX/XLSX hrefs at bare /api/export/docx and /api/export/xlsx. Source clipboard exports omit search/review/preset; some also omit selected case. No export click or actual data queried.
findings.recommendation: Centralize active scope in URL/request builder and apply consistently to results, reports and exports.

findings.issue: Clipboard success toast can lie on permission/error failure.
findings.evidence: Fixture-only fault injection rejected navigator.clipboard.writeText with NotAllowedError; copyRawJson still displayed Raw JSON tersalin ke clipboard! and emitted unhandled rejection. No clipboard write occurred.
findings.recommendation: Await all clipboard writes, catch rejection, show actionable retry/fallback.

findings.issue: Live Sync remains green when health request fails.
findings.evidence: With fetch locally stubbed to reject, pollHealth left green Live Sync (5s) unchanged; catch is empty. This was a deliberate offline fault, not a backend test.
findings.recommendation: Track last successful sync and visibly announce stale/offline/retrying state.

findings.issue: transition: all used without a reduced-motion variant.
findings.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion:reduce, button/chip/tab transitions remain0.15s; zero CSS media rules. Only short transitions observed, no long/autoplay motion.
findings.recommendation: Name transition properties and respect reduced-motion preference.
